os_targets.rationale: Matches docs/v4/ARCHITECTURE.md Checkpoint 3. Stable SwiftUI.Map annotations, SwiftData @Model containers, and CLLocationUpdate async streams are natively available on iOS 17.0+. No artificial OS exclusion.

liquid_glass_policy.baseline_ios_17: Standard high-contrast Apple system materials (Material.ultraThinMaterial, Material.thinMaterial, Material.regularMaterial) with crisp hairline borders.
liquid_glass_policy.enhancement_ios_18_plus: Where supported native Apple visual APIs exist on iOS 18+, apply them via conditional availability checks (#available(iOS 18, *)).
prohibitions: STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: Fake custom software blur shaders simulating Liquid Glass on older iOS versions.
STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: Unoptimized real-time canvas filters that drop frame rates below 60fps.
STRICTLY FORBIDDEN: Violating WCAG AA contrast for the sake of translucency.

accessibility_adaptations.reduce_transparency: Automatically falls back to opaque high-contrast system background.
accessibility_adaptations.reduce_motion: Replaces spring animations with direct fade transitions.

architecture_patterns.state_management: Modern MV pattern with @Observable macro (iOS 17+ first-party, replacing ObservableObject / @Published).
architecture_patterns.concurrency: Swift 6 strict concurrency checking enabled. All background data fetches isolated via actors and Sendable models.
architecture_patterns.persistence: SwiftData (@Model) for offline saved places and trip itineraries.
architecture_patterns.mapping: First-party SwiftUI.Map (MapKit) with declarative markers, MapPolyline for 154 transit routes, and zero binary bloat.

accessibility_compliance.dynamic_type: Full support from Extra Small to Accessibility XXXL using relative font scaling.
accessibility_compliance.voice_over: Explicit accessibilityLabels, hints, and custom accessibilityActions for trip cards and transit departures.
accessibility_compliance.minimum_touch_target: 44x44 pt minimum hit target for all interactive controls.

device_targets.iphone: Compact width, single-column tab navigation with bottom bar.
device_targets.ipad: Regular width, adaptive two/three-column NavigationSplitView with sidebar.
device_targets.orientation: Portrait primary for iPhone; all orientations for iPad.
